text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
It's down to the final stretch! The racers
pick up
the pace in a bid to win the title
of Derby
champion!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Bring it on!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I won't let you beat me! The Derby is
mine!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
No way! I won't give up! I'm winning this
for
Maruzen!

text_block_list.name: Ardan & Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaahhh!
Raaaaagh!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(...I'm going to lose. I'm being
overpowered!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I don't care if my legs shatter!
I will burn out my
very lifeforce! And that light will
serve as proof
that I was alive!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no, no, nooo! The Derby's mine!
It's
miiiiine!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(...No! Losing is not an option.
I will not...

abiiide... defeeeat!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
THE STRONGEEEST! THEEERE! IIIIIS!

RAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
And it's Sakura Chiyono O! Sakura
Chiyono O has
conquered the Japanese
Derby!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Amazing... Wow, my heart's still racing!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Chiyo. Thank you,
everybody. What
an incredible Derby!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I... did iiiiit!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Maruzen! Maruzen! I... won the Derby!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
You sure did! Congrats, Chiyo! You ran

wonderfully!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: And... thank you.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Sob... I'm so happyyyyy! Waaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh, Chiyo, you little darling... Ehehe!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: In that moment... I...

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
You were so intense, Yaeno! I had
goosebumps!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, what a great race! It felt like you
were all
duking it out with your very
souls!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...R-really?!

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
It was definitely one for the record
books!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...Much obliged!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno. Ardan. Thanks a ton for running
with me!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
And, um, also! I know this might come
off as
arrogant, but...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad I was able to compete in the
Derby
with you two!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Likewise.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I would like to express my gratitude to
the both
of you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: What for?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
It was your incredible passion that drew
today's
performance out of me.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I didn't want to be outdone... I wanted
to light my
soul ablaze and burn just as
brightly as you two.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Are you saying that we were visibly
glowing?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: In my eyes, you certainly were.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Your very souls were aglow, lit by your

determination to claim victory no matter
the cost.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I was entranced by the way you ran.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: My! Is that so...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I may not have claimed the achievement
I so ardently wanted, but it appears I
still managed to
leave proof of my
existence...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I certainly think so. Your brilliant image
is deeply
burned onto my heart.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Same! I don't think I'll ever be able to
forget this
race!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: But I won't be defeated next time!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. The day I best you will surely
come.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I can't wait to run with you two again!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Laughing mirthfully, the three shake
hands. But in
stark contrast...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki's expression is meek when
she
returns to the waiting room. There's
no trace of
her smile from the turf.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I have to reflect on my shameful
behavior. I made
a grave mistake which
cannot be ignored.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I let my emotions get the better of me
near the
end of the race, and ran to the
whims of my own
competitive drive.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
The powerful cries Chiyono O and Ardan
let out from deep within their souls
overwhelmed me and
stole away my
reason...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
It was as if I was hearing my own
impending
defeat.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
But in that same instant, the fierce blaze
within me cried out. They refused to
take defeat lying
down and urged me to
fight back!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
My blood started boiling, and I became
furious. I
tried to stop my rampaging
legs, but to no avail.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...I was on the verge of losing control.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I agree. And I am satisfied with today's
results.
choice_data_list: Still, that's exactly why it was s...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I had an incredible race with Chiyono O
and
Ardan, and I was able to run at my
very best.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, it was the very best that I can do

currently. But...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Had I not let loose my emotions, I would
have
been left behind with no hope of
fighting for the
lead.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
My lack of strength and inexperience
are to
blame, and that must not be
overlooked.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Close matches between racers of equal
prowess
are oftentimes won by whoever
has greater
willpower.
choice_data_list: In the end, it can sometimes come ...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today's race was one such instance. As
such, I tell
her there's no need to feel
discouraged.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
But... I cannot guarantee that I won't
lose control
if I find myself in the same
circumstances again.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Justifying such a volatile running style
would be
irresponsible...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
By improving her running ability and
strategy, she should be able to win
without letting her
emotions run
rampant.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Very well. I agree that's our best
approach.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Phew... I'm relieved we're in accord.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I'll be counting on you to help me
deliver a stable
performance at the
Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's highly likely that Sakura Chiyono O
and Mejiro Ardan will be at the Kikuka
Sho, given
that it's the final race in the
Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
As do I. But I'm also looking forward to
it.
choice_data_list: Looks like it's going to be anothe...
Looks like it'll be another tough ...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
For it will be my chance to have an even
greater
battle against Chiyono O and
Ardan!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's clear from her smile that Yaeno
Muteki has a burning desire to reach
even greater heights with
her rivals at
the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, a few days later...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We receive unexpected news that Sakura
Chiyono O and Mejiro Ardan will
both be taking
time off from racing due
to injuries.
